title.en: Restore Windows' own CPU boost mode
title.tr: İşlemci hız artırma kipini Windows'un kendi değerine döndür

why.en: Another tool can move the boost mode away from the one Windows ships, which puts an efficiency policy between the game and the highest clock speed.
why.tr: Başka bir araç hız artırma kipini Windows'un getirdiği değerden uzaklaştırabilir; bu da oyun ile en yüksek saat hızı arasına bir verimlilik ilkesi koyar.

fixed.en: The CPU boost mode is back to Windows' own value, so the highest clock speed is requested whenever conditions allow.
fixed.tr: İşlemci hız artırma kipi Windows'un kendi değerine döndü, bu yüzden koşullar elverdiğinde en yüksek saat hızı isteniyor.

apply: $s = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\User\PowerSchemes' -Name ActivePowerScheme -ErrorAction Stop).ActivePowerScheme; powercfg.exe /setacvalueindex $s 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 be337238-0d82-4146-a960-4f3749d470c7 $Target | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'powercfg could not set the value.' }; powercfg.exe /setactive $s | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'powercfg could not re-activate the plan.' }
revert: $s = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\User\PowerSchemes' -Name ActivePowerScheme -ErrorAction Stop).ActivePowerScheme; $d = [int](Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerSettings\54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00\be337238-0d82-4146-a960-4f3749d470c7\DefaultPowerSchemeValues\381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e' -Name ACSettingIndex -ErrorAction Stop).ACSettingIndex; powercfg.exe /setacvalueindex $s 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 be337238-0d82-4146-a960-4f3749d470c7 $d | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'powercfg could not set the value.' }; powercfg.exe /setactive $s | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'powercfg could not re-activate the plan.' }
